title: Prefill: indexer logits + exact top-k
shape: DEP16 F16K (3 x 5,461 tok) at L78K, NVFP4, per GPU, 24 DSA layers
basis: PROJECTED (reviewed ledger, perf-model/plan/nvfp4_ledgers_summary.txt); 1-GPU stock microbench at the deployed shape running
gap_analysis: Stock prefill indexer per layer (per GPU): 12 chunks (512 MB logits budget -> 1712 rows x 78K keys per chunk), each = DeepGEMM sm100_mqa_logits (MXFP4 x MXFP4 with the 1x-K block-scaled MMA, BF16 logits written to HBM) + trtllm_gvr2 BF16 exact top-k re-reading the logits. Model achievable per layer: idx_score 1.206 ms (bound 'simt': FP32 relu + head-weight FMA epilogue) + topk 0.188 ms. READ FROM SOURCE (not yet measured): the stock DeepGEMM epilogue is NOT FP32: it is cvt.rn.relu.bf16x2.f32 + packed BF16 HFMA2 with BF16 weights (4 BF16 partial lanes, hadd2 combine), so the model's FP32-SIMT epilogue term over-prices stock math by about 2x (model error, to be confirmed by measurement).
inefficiencies: HYPOTHESIS: logits materialised in HBM (BF16, ~2.5 GB/layer write + >=1 read by the top-k)
HYPOTHESIS: stock MMA uses the sm_100 1x-K MXF4 descriptor (half the sm_107 FP4 rate)
Multi-pass sampling top-k (GVR) over the materialised logits, 12 chunk launches per layer
Model: idx_score epilogue priced as FP32 SIMT while stock is packed BF16 (model too pessimistic)
rubin_features: 2x-K block-scaled MMA (mxf4 K128) via sm_107a descriptors
oversized shared memory for per-row histograms
plan: Measure stock per-layer time and kernel split at the deployed shape (1 GPU microbench)
Root-cause logits kernel vs model (MMA kind, epilogue issue rate) and top-k passes
Design fused sm_107 logits + exact single-pass histogram select (no logits round trip), exact graph-safe overflow path
Numerics test vs stock logits (bitwise where order unchanged) + exact top-k test
Microbench vs model, then step A/B with INFRA step_p harness
Land in vllm/models/kimi_k3/nvidia/specialized_prefill with stock wiring only

work.what: Read stock path (sparse_attn_indexer chunk loop, DeepGEMM sm100_mqa_logits source from the image, trtllm_gvr2 prefill)
work.result: stock epilogue is packed BF16 (cvt relu bf16x2 + hfma2), logits BF16; 12 chunks/layer at 512 MB budget
